name: CompareBars
intent: The dual-bar comparison primitive: two hero percentages, a variance pill, a legend, and stacked bars. ProgressComparison composes it for its hero block, so the bars can also be used standalone.
when: Comparing two progress figures (e.g. planned vs actual) as hero bars
Building a custom comparison layout from the shared bar primitive

chooseOver.because: CompareBars is only the hero bars; ProgressComparison is the full comparison widget (milestone stepper, stats) that composes it

notes: authored during the develop merge reconciliation

props.name: primary
props.description: Left / primary source, rendered dark — most commonly the actual / approved value.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Right / secondary source, rendered lighter — most commonly the planned / baseline value.

props.name: variance
props.description: Variance shown in the pill. Defaults to `primary.value - secondary.value`.

props.name: size
props.description: Density. `compact` (default) matches the ProgressComparison panel; `default` is a touch larger.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.
